lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance clusters to form a structured grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.
